Package board.typeOfBoard

Class DefinedBoard

java.lang.Object
board.Board
board.typeOfBoard.DefinedBoard
public class DefinedBoard extends Board
A board with a randomly generated path. The path can go up, down, left, or right. Each cell is used only once to avoid loops.
